wire.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
wire.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

wire.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence

items.title: Computing Normal-Form Correlated Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games is in PPAD
items.summary: We study the computational complexity of finding any normal-form correlated equilibria (NFCE for short) in the succinct games of extensive-form with perfect recall, which is considered as a major open problem in algorithmic game theory. items.title: A consequence of the classical Lindelöf Hypothesis for the density of zeros of general Dirichlet series
items.summary: Supposing the Lindelöf Hypothesis for the Riemann zeta function we prove that the density hypothesis holds for Res>3/4 for a large class of Dirichlet series. The first result of similar type was reached by Gábor Halász and Paul Turán in 1969.

items.summary: We prove the Tate conjecture for non-CM and non-ordinary abelian fourfolds over positive characteristic function fields. items.title: The Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer formula for CM elliptic curves of analytic rank one
items.summary: In this article, we prove the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer formula for elliptic curves over the field of rational numbers with complex multiplication and analytic rank one.

items.title: The Yau Geometric Conjecture for Isolated Hypersurface Singularities
